ourStory.title: OUR STORY
ourStory.intro: Kamancha is more than just a restaurant. It is a harmonious blend of Armenian culture, music, and gastronomy. We take age-old traditions and present them to the modern world, keeping the warmth that belongs only to an Armenian hearth.
ourStory.introSecond: Every dish is prepared with love, using local fresh produce and spices brought from different corners of Armenia.
ourStory.cardBodyShort: Every dish is prepared with love, using local fresh ingredients
